PLANNED on Anthony's word, 2026-09-14, from the session plan he confirmed. Follows epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment. NO VERSION NUMBER BY DESIGN (dec:idea-a-planned-increment-is-named-by-content-not-by-number).

THE THEME. dec:reflow2-serves-source-reading-analyses-that-report-and-never-write is ACCEPTED on his word with three conditions: no configuration; never quietly guesses; reports and never writes. The wall check is served (chg:the-wall-check-is-served), with the gate that fails this repo's build when a capability promises reach it does not have. Three analyses remain from his "fix this for all 4": clone detection, protocol enumeration, and the profile survey.

THE ORDER OF WORK, and why it is blocked on him and not on code: each analysis needs its question DEFINED IN HIS TERMS before anything is built — what counts as a clone, what counts as a protocol, what a profile is — which is exactly the guess the consumer's agent refused to make. ASK, then build one at a time. Each ships only with the three consumer legs: served as a tool, named in a skill at the moment of use, and seen by the consumer-reach gate (req:an-analysis-a-consumer-needs-is-served-named-and-gated).

WHAT IS NOT IN IT. No analysis built on a definition reflow2 guessed. No analysis that writes design back. No fourth analysis nobody asked for. The field-report root-causes are the previous increment, not this one.
properties.name: PLANNED — the three remaining source-reading analyses, each defined in Anthony's terms before it is built, each shipped with all three consumer legs
